Ever wonder why sermorelin exists if we have synthetic growth hormone (GH)? 

Thread on why secretagogues like sermorelin are their own category—and why GH isn’t a default 1:1 replacement. ↓
Synthetic GH delivers growth hormone directly. It’s precise but bypasses your body’s feedback loops. This can suppress natural GH production over time.
Secretagogues like sermorelin stimulate your body to produce its own GH. This preserves natural feedback mechanisms—but results vary based on individual biology.
GH replacement is useful in deficiency states, but for optimization, sermorelin may offer a gentler approach by working *with* your body’s systems, not overriding them.
That said, sermorelin isn’t a silver bullet. It requires careful monitoring, labs, and clinician oversight to ensure it’s right for you.
